headline: Indigenous leadership structures arrive in the national ecosystem
digest: Mila and CIFAR launched an Indigenous AI Advisory Circle of six Indigenous leaders to guide Indigenous participation across CIFAR and the three national AI institutes, and Mila opened the third cohort of Indigenous Pathfinders in AI, a seven-week program for Indigenous professionals building community projects. The Council of Ontario Universities' AI Task Force set out a four-pillar sector plan covering student and workforce readiness, responsible use, partnerships and public trust.
